verdict.rationale: AngelList's docs cover the separate pieces of this story: board consents can be generated and signed on-platform, Equity Blocks let boards pre-approve standard grants, 409A valuations can be requested in-app, and grants are e-signed with automatic cap table updates. However, nothing shows the 409A value setting the strike price inside the grant flow, or the steps running as one connected workflow. AngelList's own update FAQ also says it is helping customers transition to other cap table providers, which casts doubt on whether this capability is still offered. Missing for 10: a documented link between the 409A valuation and the option strike price, evidence of a single end-to-end issuance workflow, confirmation the equity product is still available, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue options to a new hire with a board approval flow and a 409A-compliant strike price in one end-to-end workflow
